blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A 63-year-old American tourist died after he was allegedly struck with a chair during a fistfight at a bar in Panglao, Bohol, late Saturday. Sept. 27, police said. The victim, identified by his alias “Williams,” was staying at a resort in Barangay Tawala, Panglao. Initial investigation showed the incident happened at Escape Bar along Alona Beach. READ: American shot dead in Rizal robbery According to the Bohol Tourist Police Unit, a concerned citizen reported the altercation at 11:45 p.m., prompting tourist police personnel to respond.
